arStrings.szText: The stones of the Ancients' tomb trembled as their clash began—Nilphae, fledgling Priest of Rathma, against the titan centipede. Blow after blow, Nilphae's attacks glanced off its scaley armor, but when it lunged to swallow her whole, Nilphae smiled wide...and whispered to the army of corpses deep in the titan's belly.
Woe to the eater of the dead.
